title: Fixed already encoded media URLs during import
summary: Architecture: the importer downloads a remote media URL and saves the returned file locally. Problem: encodeURI encodes existing percent escapes again, so cover%20image.png becomes cover%2520image.png and the server may return 404. Solution: use standard URL serialization to encode raw spaces while preserving existing URL escapes.
validation: Proposed media importer fix. Test percent-encoded spaces, Unicode, percent signs, encoded slashes and query values, plus raw-space controls.
